plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a writer named Agnew Bahnson and his late-1950s novel The Stars Are Too High. Michels says the book is about rogue Nazi scientists who break away and work with American scientists. He raises it because, to him, the story may hint at real secret work that went on after the Second World War.
